about.title: About the Legend of Blue Eyes White Dragon set
paragraphs: Legend of Blue Eyes White Dragon is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG booster set released on 8 March 2002, in the Duel Monsters era. It has 126 cards, and with the 3 other rarities there are 129 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 126 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 129, adding the 3 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
